description: This file defines classes related to warning reporting categories, including state management for plugin warnings, message handling for long-running operations, and flow control metrics within the Thunder::WarningReporting namespace.

classes.name: TooLongPluginState
classes.description: Represents the state of a plugin warning, including analysis, serialization, deserialization, and string conversion functionalities.

classes.name: TooLongInvokeMessage
classes.description: Handles messages indicating long invocation durations, supporting multiple message types and serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: FlowControlQueueSize
classes.description: Represents flow control queue size metrics with serialization and string conversion.

classes.name: FlowControlJobTime
classes.description: Represents flow control job time metrics with serialization and string conversion.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Analyzes and sets internal state based on input parameters for warning conditions.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the object state into a buffer for transmission or storage.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes object state from a buffer.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the object state into a human-readable string.
